caption: The drawing features three orthographic views (top, side, and front elevations) of a chair, depicted in black ink on an off-white or yellowed paper background. The top elevation shows a rectangular seat with rounded front corners and ornate carvings on the top corners and back. The side elevation displays the chair's straight, gently sloping backrest, a lightly cushioned seat, and elegantly curved front legs ending in rounded feet, with the back legs extending straight down. The front elevation illustrates the decorative carved backrest featuring symmetrical, curving designs and a circular motif at the center near the base, as well as the carved front legs and simple, rectangular seat frame. The drawing includes dimensions in inches (height: 38", seat depth: 16", seat width: 15 3/4" at the front, overall width at the back: 20 3/8", and overall depth: 22"), along with annotations about the drawing's scale (1/8" = 1"), the owner, and a note about visible dowel pins. The composition adheres to typical architectural drafting methods, with dashed lines indicating measurement points and elevation cut lines.
title: Chair
